svg.text: Generated by tools/previews/record_figures.py from decisions/register.yaml. Drafted at independence level I0; nothing shown here is reviewed, verified or accepted.

g.text: Terms: AI = artificial intelligence (here, an AI assistant drafting at independence level I0) · CONOPS = concept of operations · DoD = US Department of Defense · DQ-nnn = decision
question for the project lead (decisions/register.yaml) · EC-nnn = edge case found by a failure search · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) · I0–I3 =
review independence level (I0 none, e.g. the author or an AI, to I3 independent organisation) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) ·
PDaC = Product Development as Code · TS-nnn = architecture trade study · UAV = uncrewed aerial vehicle (drone) · US = United States
